sentence: Ur tezmireḍ ara ad txedmeḍ d yiwen ma ulac lemqadra gar-awen.
credits: Sentence from Tatoeba by Aghanim (CC-BY 2.0 FR)
translations: It's impossible to collaborate without mutual respect.

usageExamples: Ur ssineɣ ara ad mmeslayeɣ i medden.
